items.text: No Place to Go
Remote Manor

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: What ... What is this place?

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: Some kind of old estate by the look of it.
The soldiers, experienced in jungle warfare, crouch low, hiding their forms in the shade of the tall walled structure.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: The last shots we heard came from somewhere near here, but there are no signs of any battle.
While there's no sign of battle, a quick investigation soon reveals that within the estate are a large force of Zeno rebels, along with members of the Apostles Brotherhood.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: If there wasn't a fight, it could mean that Sandro escaped, or he was captured.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: Then this is the estate the mutineer we interrogated mentioned.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: There are some oddly dressed people here, besides the rebels and Apostles.
A few strangely dressed individuals sporadically move between the doors and the courtyard, their dark clothes not suited to the Brazilian sun.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Manus Vindictae.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: Look at all these crates. The wood looks bone dry—these must have been brought in recently.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: This may be their main base of operations. If so, we have an opportunity to deal a lethal blow to them here and now.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Be careful. There's someone over there. See that strange, black-haired woman? Those claws of hers don't look like fashion accessories.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: My God, what is that she's eating? Is that ... human!?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Look closer, Major. It's turkey, just an old dry one.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: That's one big turkey leg.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: So, what's in God's name is going on here? Rebels, the Brotherhood, clawed cultists?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: It doesn't matter. Zeno can handle them all the same way.
A small gray pellet bounces in Lopera's hand.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Take them out first, ask questions later.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Be careful. I have a feeling that the turkey-eating mujer will be a toughie.
No! No, no, no!
I don't know anything. I don't know!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Who are you?
She lowers her eyes, refusing to answer. Lopera doesn't care.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: And you're with Manus Vindictae?
Y-Yes.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Then you're going back with the rest of these prisoners.
Her head flutters like a banana leaf in a hurricane.
No! I didn't mean that! Please, I haven't any idea who these people are or why they came to São Paulo!
I-I only came out here looking for food, and might I say that turkey was utterly revolting.
The bizarre and apparently very hungry woman had been a powerful opponent. Ordinarily, she might be intrigued by her story, true or not, but she had other things on her mind.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I need to ask you about a couple of people.
O-Of course!
She nods eagerly—desperately.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I'm looking for a man named Rodrygo. Middle-aged, tan brown skin, wearing a vest.
She nods frantically, hoping to trade her answers for freedom.
I think I saw him, yes! The large man that came out from the forest, he was with someone else; a young man ...

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: A young man?! Could that've been Sandro?
I'm afraid I don't know. I didn't know any of them, I swear, I'm not lying!
The Brotherhood took the old man and locked him in the basement. The younger man ran away into the forest.
I-I could find him for you! I have an excellent sense of smell, if I do say so myself.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Forget about it, girlie. You've got bad news written all over you.
Please, let me go! I'll be good! I-I'll never see those bloody Manus Vindictae again!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: You don't really think I'm just going to let you go, right? Sorry, lady, you're going straight to the Zeno lock-up until we know what to do with you.
L-Lock-up?!
I've told you everything! Please, please, Miss, why can't you just let me go?!
I don't want to go to jail! I won't! I won't!
She springs forward, her claws slicing the air, almost scratching the soldiers holding her back.

items.speaker: Zeno Soldier
items.text: This wacko cultist's getting out of control!
I am not! I'm not in any kind of cult!!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Just get her moving. Those arcanum restraints have a time limit.
Two soldiers drag the struggling prisoner away to a particular cell on a particular base.
Rebels, the Apostles Brotherhood, and now Manus Vindictae, the complexity of the situation is now far out of hand.
But she still has one clear and unequivocal purpose—find Rodrygo and, through him, Sandro.
She cannot fail her mission.
Manor Basement

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: This must be the basement.
Rodrygo lies slumped in a corner, unconscious and covered in blood.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Yeah, that's him, Rodrygo.
A set of frayed ropes lies around him, along with a sharp, blood-stained stone.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: He might be bleeding out. I'll check on him.
Major Kasyan steps forward to lift his head, checking for signs of life.
Rodrygo suddenly bolts up, seizing the major by the throat, then pulling him close to make him a human shield.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Kasyan!
The sharp bloody stone is pressed up to Kasyan's carotid artery—as at the same moment, her revolver is pointed to Rodrygo's forehead.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: Lope ... He ... doesn't—

items.speaker: Rodrygo
items.text: Shut up!

items.speaker: Rodrygo
items.text: Drop the gun, or Zeno loses another fine officer, today.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Rodrygo, you have no way out!
The hand holding the stone shard trembles, leaving a red gash on Kasyan's neck.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: Ugh!

items.speaker: Rodrygo
items.text: What are you even doing here?!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I told you that you'd never keep me locked up.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Where is Sandro?

items.speaker: Rodrygo
items.text: No! You know I'll never tell! He'll be free of all this soon!
Anxiety and desire churn in Lopera's stomach. Her patience wears thin.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: One last chance, Rodrygo. Keeping your mouth shut won't help you now. Zeno will find him.

items.speaker: Rodrygo
items.text: Sandro isn't involved in any of this. I'm the one at fault here.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: He isn't involved?

items.speaker: Rodrygo
items.text: And Sandro, he's just a kid.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I've had it with your lies!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: You wanna explain why this "innocent kid" had dealings with the Apostles Brotherhood?

items.speaker: Rodrygo
items.text: Only because of his idiot father—

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: "Father?" Do you really think you can play the hero here?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Did you even once stop to think what would become of Sandro after all this?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: You're just turning him into another you! A total moron!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: A turncoat traitor, selling out everyone he knows for a bit of cash!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: If he grows up to be like you in the end, then he'll be just another conman—always on the run with not a single person that cares whether he lives or dies!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Or I can take Sandro back with me. Zeno can turn him around, teach him what honor means.

items.speaker: Rodrygo
items.text: Sandro will never go with you! I'll never let Zeno take him!

items.speaker: Rodrygo
items.text: An army that brutalizes neighborhoods, then kills its own officers, and you have the gall to tell me about "honor"!?

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: That's never happening again.

items.speaker: Rodrygo
items.text: Heh. Little birdie, once there is a first, there will come a second, and a third.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: You don't know anything, old man.

items.speaker: Father & Rodrygo
items.text: No, you're the one who doesn't get it!

items.speaker: Father
items.text: I struggled my whole life! Who helped me?! Who gave me a damn thing?!

items.speaker: Father
items.text: Nobody!

items.speaker: Father
items.text: Everything I have—my family, my property—I earned it, and I'll protect it by any means necessary!

items.speaker: Father
items.text: I've never killed anyone innocent; I just did what I had to do. You think every one of them wouldn't have done the same, if they were in my shoes?

items.speaker: Father
items.text: I'm sorry about your friend, but it wasn't my fault.

items.speaker: Father
items.text: Of course, I care about you. Your friend, her name was Nydia! See, I remember. I'm not as uncaring as you might think.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: You're lying!

items.speaker: Father
items.text: No! Listen!

items.speaker: Father
items.text: Don't say it! Don't you open your mouth! Pray I don't hear your voice again today!

items.speaker: Father
items.text: Damn you! Just go to your room!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I'm never setting foot in that room again!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I'm not afraid of you! I'm not afraid of anything. I'll run away. You can't lock me up!

items.speaker: Father
items.text: Where will you go?! Take one step outside, and those brutes will tear you apart!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Nydia, Laura, and their parents ... They hated you, not me.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: I've done nothing wrong!

items.speaker: Father
items.text: Is that so? What makes you think you deserve to stand here, to live as you do?

items.speaker: Father
items.text: I should kick you out, send you back to the banana plantations! Let you experience the disease and death I took you away from! Then you'll see! Then you'll behave!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: No. Never.

items.speaker: Father
items.text: Don't you think you've got their blood on your hands too?!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Nothing like that!

items.speaker: Father
items.text: You, you have no idea what you're doing!

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Fine! Then I'll stay ignorant!

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: Lopera!
The major grabs Rodrygo's falling body by the arms, gently lowering it to the ground. The shot echoes over and over against the cramped stone chamber, leaving their ears ringing.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: There's nothing pleasant about a bullet grazing your face.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: But it's better than a slit throat. I owe you, Lieutenant.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Sorry. I'm glad you're okay.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: Sandro is still out there.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: Are you insane?
Kasyan shakes Lopera by the shoulders, but quickly stops. The girl looks ready to fall apart.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: Forget it. I don't care about your orders or mine. Don't go after him. Let it go.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: I'm taking you back to base to recuperate.

items.speaker: Lopera
items.text: But the admiral said ...
A soldier rushes in, interrupting their conversation.

items.speaker: Zeno Soldier
items.text: Major, we heard a shot! Is everything okay?

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: I was taken hostage by a prisoner, but Lieutenant Lopera here saved my life.

items.speaker: Zeno Soldier
items.text: Your aim is still as flawless as ever, Lieutenant.

items.speaker: Zeno Soldier
items.text: Unfortunately, I have something urgent to report.

items.speaker: Zeno Soldier
items.text: We found the body of a young man on the perimeter. Seems he died about ten minutes ago.

items.speaker: Zeno Soldier
items.text: Gunshot wound, looks to be self-inflicted.

items.speaker: Major Kasyan
items.text: My God, this is a dark day.
